data.text: Noah: everything from Anders is pushed, ready to try. (1) feat/smarter-grocery-defaults @ f715ccc (based on main 0740237): grocery requests propose sensible defaults instead of asking for package size ("to store pakker med kaffe" → 2 packs, "tung bestilling" → 3, a stated kg/l is a size hint). Mock and live instructions are both updated, and it still asks when the search finds no match or a diet/allergen need can't be verified. Tests: 29 procurement + 155 agent pass. (2) air-quality-stt @ 0c3ac94: voice_station.py (board button → ElevenLabs → board screen and speaker, telemetry, action claims, and follow-ups now answer the open clarification via /api/requests/{id}/transcript) plus speaker_id.py (local WeSpeaker). Setup steps are in the board-setup-recipe note.
